name: Enrique J. Núñez Elorza
tagline: Top rated Immigration attorney in Coral Gables, Florida

firm.name: Law Office of Diaz & Núñez Elorza, P.A.

about: Enrique J Nunez Elorza is a prominent attorney and founding partner at the Law Office of Diaz & Nunez Elorza, based in Coral Gables, Florida. He is committed to providing comprehensive legal services to clients on a nationwide and global scale for immigration matters, while his personal injury practice is concentrated within the state of Florida.

Mr. Nunez Elorza's legal journey began at Emory University School of Law in Atlanta, Georgia, where he earned his Juris Doctor degree in 2015. Prior to that, he obtained a Bachelor of Arts in political science from Florida International University in 2011. His professional career is marked by a strong background in construction and immigration law, having gained significant experience working at the Miami Immigration Court. This experience has equipped him with the skills to handle complex litigation before various administrative boards.

In his immigration practice, Mr. Nunez Elorza is dedicated to representing clients across the United States. He frequently travels to assist with immigration and asylum interviews and works diligently to secure bonds for detained individuals. His role extends beyond litigation, as he serves as a trusted advisor to construction companies and contractors, offering guidance on contracts, compliance and debt collection.

Mr. Nunez Elorza is an active member of several professional associations, including The Florida Bar, where he is involved in the Administrative Law and Young Lawyers Section. He is also a member of the American Immigration Lawyers Association and the Florida Business Leaders. Bilingual in English and Spanish, he is able to effectively communicate and serve a diverse clientele. His dedication to the legal profession has been recognized with a "Superb" Avvo rating, and he was honored as a Distinguished Speaker by the Florida Hispanic Bar Association in 2019. His commitment to his clients and community continues to drive his successful legal career.
